_comment: Static address mapping for the rekon10 fleet: addresses, not names.
There is known DNS instability on this network; observed 2026-09-13, the coordinator
resolved consistently by name and no campod resolved at all. No cause established.
These are DHCP leases and can move -- when one does, this file is the place to change it.
Unflashed units are listed with enabled:false so the roster is complete and bringing one
into service is a one-word change.
